Group rides in Denton, TX

8 recurring group rides around Denton, TX: 5 road, 3 social. 4 roll on weeknights, 4 on weekends. New to group rides? Start with Monday Community Ride in Denton — it's no-drop, nobody gets left. Want to go fast? PBA Tuesday Night Ladies Ride runs no-drop; C group 15.5–17 mph, D group 14–15.5 mph.
